name: Philadelphia Gas Works (PGW)
notes: Researched from public pgworks.com pages only. My Account sign-in uses email and password (Forgot email? / Forgot password?); registration requires having received a first bill. My Account payments from checking/savings are free; card fee in My Account is not stated (PGW guest and phone card payments cost $2.65, used for cards). Pay as a guest (no login) by bank or card with a $2.65 convenience fee (guest link goes to an i-doxs host). AutoPay, E-bill and billing history are My Account features; AutoPay method/timing/cancel not published (family defaults, cancel inferred). Payment Agreement Plans and Budget Billing are arranged by phone (Collection Department 215-235-1777; 215-235-1000) or in person, so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. Stop service online requires My Account; notify at least seven days ahead. MyCheckFree stopped processing PGW payments March 15, 2024.

autopay_cancel.note: Manage or stop Autopay from My Account.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment Agreement Plans are arranged by phone with the Collection Department at 215-235-1777 or in person at a Customer Service Center.

cancel_service.note: Please give PGW at least seven days notice. You are responsible for gas used until PGW can reach the meter to shut it off.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Pay with My Account: payments from a checking or savings account are free. Pay as a guest without logging in by checking, savings or credit card for a $2.65 convenience fee.

Pay by phone 24 hours a day at (215) 235-1000 with your account number (a $2.65 convenience fee may apply), or mail a check or money order payable to Philadelphia Gas Works with your account number to P.O. Box 11700, Newark, NJ 07101-4700. Cash payments are free at participating local retailers; other payment centers may charge a fee.
MyCheckFree stopped processing PGW payments on March 15, 2024.

help.title: Payment assistance
paragraphs: The Customer Responsibility Program (CRP) can cut monthly gas bills for low-income customers by more than 50%. LIHEAP cash, crisis and hardship grants help households facing shutoff or broken heating equipment, and CARES helps customers with medical emergencies, unemployment or other hardship.

Budget Billing spreads your yearly gas cost evenly over 12 months for residential customers in good standing. Call 215-235-1000 about Budget Billing or payment options, or the Collection Department at 215-235-1777 about a Payment Agreement Plan.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: To turn off service online you need a PGW My Account; log in or register first. Notify PGW at least seven days before the shutoff, or call (215) 235-1000. You are responsible for gas used until PGW can access the meter.
Moving within Philadelphia? Complete both a turn on and a turn off request. Landlords stopping service for a tenant must submit a notarized Voluntary Discontinuance Form signed by all tenants.

extra.intent: Using the PGW website's help pages, find the convenience fee for paying as a guest. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Find the phone number PGW customers call to set up a Payment Agreement Plan. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
